correctness.rationale: The frozen bound |D^c|<=e(D,D^c)<=|D| forces size at least n, attained by either layer. At equality each vertex has exactly one opposite-class neighbour, and conversely such a labelling pairs its two classes across the cut. Each marked closed transfer walk gives exactly one indexed column word (successive overlaps recover it) and vice versa, including n=3 at k=1 and n=5 at k=2. The independently reproduced cyclic components have lengths 1,1,4 at k=1 and 1,1,5,5 at k=2; each cyclic component is a simple directed cycle, so it contributes its length exactly at multiples of that length. The repair additionally proves the retained claim without computation: any crossing spoke forces its neighbouring spokes to cross, giving the two layer words. With no crossing spoke, each column has a common bit and the two ring neighbours have different bits; equivalently x_(i+2)=1-x_i. The four initial conditions all have least period four and are exactly the shifts of (0,0,1,1) in whole columns, closing precisely when 4 divides n.
residual_risks: Finite replays corroborate the exact local constraints. For the repaired theorem arbitrary n follows from propagation and the two-step anti-periodicity, not finite testing.
